description: arXiv:2604.08568v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The widespread use of LLM-based writing assistance has raised an interesting question about the homogenization of English. As LLMs tend to revise texts toward mainstream English conventions reflected in their training data, the subtle fingerprints that reflect an author's native language (L1) may be gradually disappearing.
